title: 第七章 薅呀薅羊毛第八章 蔷薇酒吧
content_zh:
练了一会儿剑，王腾将其放回兵器室。
出来后换成练拳。
那名练剑的学员见了，又是一阵摇头，武道修炼在精而不在多。
就王腾这样练两遍剑法，又去练拳法，还不如只练一种，否则到最后，肯定是两种都练不好。
“这新来的，勤奋是勤奋，就是傻了点。”
王腾还不知道自己竟然被人贴上了“傻”
的标签。
他练了两遍拳法，觉得对基础拳法的掌握也是又熟练了几分，嗯，效果不错。
一转头，看到一个高大的身影双手环抱站在旁边。
看样子，已经看了有一会儿了。
“老师，你什么时候来的，怎么也不说话，吓我一跳。”
这个人影就是昨晚教王腾【全国第九套广播练体操】的那名武徒导师，现在看到他王腾还是有点头皮发麻。
“少年，我看你练了有一会儿了，你的拳，不错！”
导师冲着王腾竖起大拇指。
“谢谢夸奖！”
王腾汗颜，说道：“老师，我叫王腾，还不知道你叫什么呢？”
“我叫彭海，你也不用叫我老师，叫一声彭师兄就好。”
彭海说道。
“彭师兄。”
王腾从善如流，随后问道：“你也这么早来的吗？”

“我天赋不够，二十多岁了，仍是高级武徒，只能靠努力了啊。”
彭海怅然道。
王腾顿时不知道说什么好了。
“哈哈哈，不要在意，我只是随便发发牢骚，王腾，你天赋不错，又肯努力，我相信用不了三年，你一定会成为一名武者，好好加油吧。”
彭海鼓励道。
三年？
不，大概三天就够了！
王腾这么想着，不过他只能点头道：“我会努力的，彭师兄！”
“好了，我去三楼训练，今天会有其他的高级武徒负责指导你们，当然，你有什么问题也可以随时找我。”
彭海说道。
“真是一个热情的师兄！”
王腾望着他走上三楼，不由感慨道。
没过多久，陆陆续续有学员到来，训练厅内逐渐热闹起来。
“师兄。”
“师兄早啊！”
“师姐，今天还是这么漂亮！”
content_en:
After practicing the sword for a while, Wang Teng put it back in the weapons room.
After coming out, I switched to boxing.
The student who was practicing swordsman shook his head again when he saw this. Martial arts training is about being good, not too much.
Just like Wang Teng practicing swordsmanship twice and then boxing, it would be better to practice only one kind, otherwise in the end, he will definitely not be able to practice both well.
"This new guy is diligent, but he's just a little stupid."
Wang Teng still doesn’t know that he has been labeled as “stupid”
label.
He practiced the boxing technique twice and felt that he had become more proficient in the basic boxing technique. Well, the effect was good.
Turning around, I saw a tall figure standing beside him with his arms folded.
It seems that I have been watching it for a while.
"Teacher, when did you come here? Why didn't you say anything? You scared me."
This figure is the martial arts instructor who taught Wang Teng [National Ninth Broadcasting System Gymnastics] last night. Now that he sees him, Wang Teng is still a little numb.
"Young man, I see you have been practicing for a while. Your boxing is pretty good!"
The instructor gave Wang Teng a thumbs up.
"Thanks for the compliment!"
Wang Teng was ashamed and said: "Teacher, my name is Wang Teng, I still don't know what your name is?"
"My name is Peng Hai, you don't need to call me teacher, just call me Senior Brother Peng."
Peng Hai said.
"Senior Brother Peng."
Wang Teng followed the good example and asked, "Did you come so early too?"
"I'm not talented enough. I'm over 20 years old and I'm still a high-level martial artist. I can only rely on hard work."
Peng Hai said sadly.
Wang Teng suddenly didn't know what to say.
"Hahaha, don't worry, I'm just complaining casually. Wang Teng, you have great talent and are willing to work hard. I believe that in less than three years, you will become a warrior. Work hard."
Peng Hai encouraged.
Three years?
No, about three days is enough!
Wang Teng thought so, but he could only nod and said: "I will work hard, Senior Brother Peng!"
"Okay, I'm going to train on the third floor. There will be other senior martial arts disciples who will be responsible for guiding you today. Of course, if you have any questions, you can always come to me."
Peng Hai said.
"What a passionate senior brother!"
Wang Teng watched him walk up to the third floor and couldn't help but sigh.
It didn't take long for students to arrive one after another, and the training hall gradually became lively.
"Senior brother."
"Good morning, senior brother!"
"Senior sister, you are still so beautiful today!"
